'''Jorem Yange''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Jorem Yange's wife|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Yange's wife was one of [[Darth Baras]]'s infiltrators, and when she was captured by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Somminick Timmns]] in [[3653 BBY]], Yange was ordered by Baras to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her when she started spilling information. A furious Yange spent the next twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] hunting Timmns, but when he located the man on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] killed him before Yange could.

Later, he sent a message to the Wrath explaining his history with Timmns. While angry that his revenge was stolen, he understood that the Wrath had no way of knowing about his vendetta and did not hold a grudge against them, only hoping that Timmns screamed before he died.
